traceability: Every defectId is an item of docs/union-eyes/convergence/register/ue-release-debt-index-0c3.json (150 items) and, through it, of the frozen 777-defect register. This ledger adds state; it never edits frozen Gate 0 evidence and counts each defect once.

statusScale.IMPLEMENTED_NOT_VERIFIED: Source changed; no test of the behaviour on file.
statusScale.UNIT_VERIFIED: Positive and adversarial tests pass against mocks or an in-process SQL engine. No deployed row-level security was involved.
statusScale.NATIVE_VERIFIED: The repaired code ran unmodified against real PostgreSQL 15 and 16 with the combined deployed schema, runtime role and row-level security, with an adversarial cross-tenant case.
statusScale.E2E_VERIFIED: Proven through the running application over HTTP or a browser, through the proxy and routing layer.
statusScale.CLOSED: Every proof the acceptance condition requires is on file and an independent release decision has been made.

items.title: Raw-handler routes may leak an unmapped EntitlementError as 500 (intake fixed; survey of 62 routes outstanding)
Platform audit tables have no storage-authority classification; topology decision outstanding
No audit proof could be created without Azure immutable storage (strictly gated local sandbox store added; never immutable)
UE_ENVIRONMENT=local is absent from the environment-validation enum
No case-coordinator fixture: synthetic chief steward and resource-scoped supervisory mandate through the authority store
Steward claims console (/api/claims) is empty while /api/cases is not
CSP blocked eval bundles under NODE_ENV=test; production build is now the acceptance runtime
Mobile header wraps and duplicates the organization name
predev align-org-schema masks canonical schema defects
feature_flags lacked created_by/last_modified_by; every flag evaluation failed (migration 0031)
Redis retry loop logs an error every two seconds while health reports ok
Dev server instability; resolved by the production-build runtime (33/33, repeatable)

A newly filed case could not be routed: case facts carried no jurisdiction. The unit is now the owning organization (server-written at intake, exact match, never inherited); routing needs an explicit unit-scoped supervisory mandate with the assign power, sight of the queue needs a separate cases triage designation; assignment audit names the mandate. Proven on a freshly filed case with denials and revocation
History writes used the public claim id against the internal-key FK when UE_CANONICAL_BOOTSTRAP_V2=0 (notes, transitions, reassignment 500)
Workbench status names were refused by the transition route (CUPE-only vocabulary)
grievances insert failed: Django table has no DB defaults and the ORM emitted default (other Django-managed tables unswept)
grievance_events.actor_user_id was uuid for text principals (migration 0032, UNQUALIFIED)
Workflow engine fed malformed signal input (every transition threw) and escalation committed a grievance when the transition was refused
Kernel executor passed Date objects to the driver (first assignment 500); no-op reassignment left the assigned_to mirror stale; QA case-assignment rules added
Rate limiting fails open without Redis while the start-up log claims fail-closed
Cold-route latency after restart; FIPS boundary and env-enum errors on every start
Orchestrator defects: hard-coded Django password; Windows shell argument splitting
NAR sandbox gate treated NODE_ENV=production as a deployment signal (aligned with the QA session gate; one test replaced and disclosed)
/api/dashboard/stats returns tenant-wide counts (active and pending claims, high-priority claims, member count) to any member, and answers zeros on a query failure

Grievance assignment (/api/grievances/[id]/assign) requires GUID principal ids while kernel principals are text, so an escalated grievance cannot be assigned to a text-id representative; the Representative handoff is proven as a case reassignment, not as a grievance-stage assignment
Two audit stores: kernel authority events are written to public.audit_logs and route audits to audit_security.audit_logs (different column sets); reporting must read both

Three unit tests encoded the old defective history behaviour (public id in legacy mode, response shape); replaced or updated with disclosure, the legacy test now asserts the internal-key contract against the Django-shaped foreign key

ORM/physical parity sweep: 662 NOT NULL columns in 216 tables have no database default while the ORM emits DEFAULT (class of R-16; organization_members and grievances fixed). Evidence: docs/union-eyes/convergence/evidence/vs-orm-physical-parity-eba009ba6.json

16 principal columns in 8 tables are text in the ORM and uuid in the database (class of R-17; grievance_events fixed by 0032): external_document_access_grants, external_matter_access_grants, representation_authorities, employer_communications, employer_contacts, cookie_consents, ai_grievance_triages, ai_clause_reasonings, ai_copilot_sessions. They sit under RLS policies and one foreign key, so the repair needs recreated policies and the storage-authority catalog tests; scheduled with the External Counsel/Employer/WorkAid journeys

2,124 ORM-declared columns across 168 tables are absent from the physical schema (any select naming them fails); most belong to surfaces not yet exercised. Evidence: docs/union-eyes/convergence/evidence/vs-orm-physical-parity-eba009ba6.json
